hero.name: Nguyen Chi Trung
hero.description: A technically-grounded Junior Business Analyst with 1+ year of hands-on software delivery experience, bridging business requirements and technical implementation.

about.title: About Me
about.description: A technically-grounded professional with 1+ year of hands-on software delivery experience across industrial automation and B2C product environments, combined with direct involvement in business model, marketing strategy, and operations for an early-stage e-commerce platform. Comfortable bridging business requirements and technical implementation — working knowledge of SQL, process documentation (Visio/flowcharts), and requirement clarification in cross-functional teams.

bullets: Utilized Microsoft Project Professional to create and maintain project execution plans for factory automation deployments across multiple provinces (Dong Nai, Vinh Long), tracking task assignments and progress across team members.

Produced flowcharts and process documentation for 3+ PCS workflows (incl. Pellet Planning, Dosing processes) and a swimlane diagram for the DHVL4 Marine feed project using Microsoft Visio, supporting technical handover and requirement clarification for factory-level projects.
Working knowledge of SQL Server and enterprise VB.NET/.NET systems, gained through direct maintenance work on factory-floor applications.
Delivered end-to-end features for production web applications (NestJS/MongoDB backend, React/Tailwind frontend) within a daily Agile delivery cycle — sprint planning, stand-ups, and code review.

items.name: CONUT
items.subtitle: Social Group-Buying E-commerce Platform
bullets: Participated in core team discussions on business model design, marketing strategy, and day-to-day operations for a social group-buying e-commerce platform focused on agricultural produce distribution.

Analyzed and mapped 3 core business workflows (buyer group-buy journey, seller product/order management, admin approval) and reviewed the platform's technical specification against its actual implementation to identify scope gaps between planned and built features — supporting both technical delivery and business decision-making within a 3-person founding team.

items.name: Pezzel
items.subtitle: Real Estate Appointment Booking Platform
bullets: Built key frontend modules: home page, map page, broker detail, estate detail, and user profile.
Developed backend APIs for analytics tracking, appointment scheduling, estate listing, and user management.
Researched and integrated Google Maps API to visualize estate locations with custom area-drawing.

items.name: Pozzel
items.subtitle: Service-Booking Mobile Application
bullets: Developed appointment listing, detail, and acceptance screens for both user-facing and business-facing applications.
Contributed to RESTful API development for user authentication and service management.

items.name: MConcept
items.subtitle: Furniture E-commerce Website
bullets: Developed product list, product detail, homepage, and wishlist pages with responsive cross-device layout.
Built backend API endpoints for product listing, product details, and user wishlist management.

items.name: MCollection
items.subtitle: Essential Oil E-commerce Website
bullets: Built multilingual and localization support, enabling users to switch languages dynamically.
Used Zustand state management to implement a transactional cart and payment system.

items.name: Vogue Nail Bar
items.subtitle: Business Landing Page
bullets: Built a high-performance, responsive landing page with complex scroll animations optimized for cross-device compatibility.
